node.title: Re: CGI.pm not good practice, so what is good, modern, practice for reading CGI paramters? (updated)
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
See also:

  • [id://1177812] ([mod://CGI::Lite], [mod://CGI::Minimal], and [mod://CGI::Simple] have all had releases in the past 1.5 years)
  • Update: I just became aware of the new [mod://CGI::Tiny], written by [https://metacpan.org/author/DBOOK|DBOOK] and containing a set of interesting functionality.
  • [id://1182902] (personally I'm a fan of [mod://Mojolicious], and despite what you wrote [id://11132948|here], using it to replace a CGI script isn't that much more work, as I showed [id://11131500|here])
  • Also worth mentioning are [mod://PSGI] and [mod://Plack], though those are relatively low-level.
